interface_checks.result: Same WebService, same owner, exact normalized URI, actual timeout/conditional request, complete fence, cache snapshot/metadata and current valid profile agree across API/contract/current scope.
32 cumulative members including payer; 64 open-admission map entries, not a total physical execution cap. Overflow/reentry/unproven requests remain independent; RPC completion closes admission.

The optional network-path profile proof may fail into independent execution. Multi-member success requires valid actual http_freshness with matching request_profile; single-member legacy behavior remains.
source: src/web.cpp: optional read profile and members > 1 validation

interface_checks.result: Subscriber steady_clock wait is timeout plus 5000 ms; no automatic reissue or direct fetch.cancel; there is no public direct-member cancel handle or durable recovery ledger.

Each window field is independently serialized. Members reconstruct their own Json values and read text through Store::range. No full canonical_text/publication aggregate is passed to the former 8 MiB parse.

One physical ingest; each result window uses BEGIN IMMEDIATE for auth epoch, deletion/all aliases, metadata digest, current and historical publication projection. A changed same-ID metadata record fails E_REVALIDATION_STALE; new no-cache results do not require cache-hit TTL.
source: src/publication.cpp: publication history and alias fences

interface_checks.result: Payer is actual or null unknown; subscriber incremental usage is known zero even when physical association is unknown. Cache hits are zero with no shared_read; network members retain from_cache=false. Associated physical usage is not additive.

HTTP only preserves available execution details. CoreClient retains only dict usage/shared_read; MCP forwards present success fields and appends compact detail JSON to the original ToolError message without recomputation.

No-store remains an error; invalid accounting/profile/cache proofs do not suppress separately validated restrictive observations. Cache invalidation is bound to the original snapshot and metadata digest.
SHARED_READS is explicitly scoped to durable read_many; late first-item admission, grants, lease capture, persistent closure and unknown settlement remain separate from direct flights.

Cross-instance/process and direct/durable/map/crawl/search sharing, public direct-member cancellation, restart receipt recovery and full CACHE-01/B-24 acceptance remain outside the implemented scope.
